summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the InP optical-substrate chokepoint with a two-lane map: Lumentum as a reference optical-component anchor, AXT as the most direct public InP substrate exposure, and Aeluma/POET as underfollowed or speculative second-order approaches that may reduce or work around scarce InP substrate dependence. The strongest direct node fit is AXTI; ALMU and POET require much heavier evidence verification because their relevance depends on commercial adoption, not current scaled substrate supply.
